note_narrative: This recording is a training session facilitated by coach Michelle in which home care business trainee Sharon McKenzie conducted a live, unscripted role-play of a home care intake/meet-and-greet for an online coaching audience. No actual home care visit occurred and no care was delivered to any real client. The role-play depicted an intake scenario in which a prospective client family sought companionship, transportation, and light meal assistance for an elderly mother ('Miss King') living in the home with her adult daughter. Within the role-play, the care recipient is described as an independent senior managing her own personal care and medications, experiencing social isolation following the death of her husband six months prior, and diagnosed with diabetes and hypertension. The family declined personal care and medication management services. Discussed services include companionship, transportation (with mileage charges), and meal preparation assistance. The agency representative (Sharon, in role) reviewed the service agreement process, caregiver screening procedures, bonding and insurance, scheduling (Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM–7:00 PM), same-caregiver consistency with backup coverage, RN comprehensive assessment, care plan development, and bi-weekly billing with deposit. This note documents the role-play intake scenario only. Coach Michelle's business training commentary directed at the live audience is not reflected in the clinical documentation.
